text.answer: Yorick is a Fighter/Tank who fights alongside Mist Walkers and the Maiden. His empowered attack deals AD-scaling physical damage, while Mourning Mist deals magic damage and marks targets for his summons to chase.
text.counterplay: Avoid Mourning Mist and be cautious about fighting near his summons and graves.

text.answer: Nearby enemy deaths periodically create graves; Last Rites also creates a grave when it kills an enemy or damages a champion or large monster. Awakening or Mourning Mist's mark consumes nearby graves to raise Mist Walkers. These summons attack enemies and advance along a lane after entering combat there.
text.counterplay: Watch nearby graves and avoid committing into a fresh group of Mist Walkers.

Whenever Yorick uses Last Rites to score the killing blow on any enemy or damage an enemy champion or large monster, he raises a grave at their location.

text.counterplay: Respect his empowered attack in close trades and watch for graves becoming summons.

text.counterplay: Move away from the forming ring or use basic attacks to break the wall if trapped.

text.answer: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with Mist Walkers. The Maiden raises more Walkers from dead enemies and marks her attack target, letting Yorick's next basic attack consume the mark for bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health. Yorick can recast to release her to push the nearest lane.
text.counterplay: Be cautious about trading while the Maiden attacks you, and watch for her pushing a lane after release.
